from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
from experiments.ntru_e2e.evaluate import evaluate_files,validate_candidate
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); run=root/'runs/phase1'; summary=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text()); records=[]
assert (run/'config_phase1.json').read_bytes()==(root/'config_phase1.json').read_bytes()
assert summary['config_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/'config_phase1.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for index,record in enumerate(summary['instances'],1):
 name=f'instance_{index:02d}'; public_path=run/f'public/{name}.json'; public=json.loads(public_path.read_text()); result=json.loads((run/f'{name}.result.json').read_text()); evaluation=json.loads((run/f'{name}.evaluation.json').read_text())
 assert evaluation==evaluate_files(public_path,run/f'private/{name}.truth.json',run/f'{name}.result.json')
 assert set(public)=={'schema','instance_id','n','q','ring','h','distribution'}
 embedded=[ev for trial in result['trials'] for ev in trial['events']]; raw=[json.loads(line) for line in (run/f'{name}.result.events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 assert raw[:len(embedded)]==embedded
 assert record['slicer_calls_finished']==sum(ev['event']=='slicer_call_finished' for ev in raw)
 candidates=0
 for trial in result['trials']:
  assert all(any(tail) for tail in trial['guesses'])
  rows=trial.get('reduced_basis_rows')
  for candidate in trial['slicer_candidates']:
   coefficients=candidate['coefficients']; v=candidate['v']; tid=candidate['target_id']
   assert v==[sum(c*row[j] for c,row in zip(coefficients,rows)) for j in range(len(v))]
   residual=[x-t for x,t in zip(v,trial['targets'][tid])]
   assert residual==candidate['g']+[candidate['f'][position] for position in trial['C']]
   assert sum(x*x for x in residual)<=trial['public_bounds_sq'][tid]
   assert validate_candidate(public,candidate)['valid']
   candidates+=1
 records.append({'instance_id':name,'evaluation_recomputed_equal':True,'exact_candidate_vectors_checked':candidates,'raw_event_count':len(raw),'checkpoint_event_count':len(embedded),'extra_raw_events':[ev['event'] for ev in raw[len(embedded):]],'end_to_end_passed':evaluation['end_to_end_passed']})
assert len(records)==3 and any(record['end_to_end_passed'] for record in records)
assert abs(summary['online_wall_seconds']-sum(record['online_wall_seconds'] for record in summary['instances']))<1e-9
assert summary['online_wall_seconds']<=1800
assert all(record['online_wall_seconds']<=300 for record in summary['instances'][1:])
assert json.loads((root/'provenance/completion/slicer_uid_regression.stdout.txt').read_text())['status']=='passed'
for label in ['rebuild_force','slicer_uid_regression','upstream_smoke','final_tests']:
 assert json.loads((root/f'provenance/completion/{label}.command.json').read_text())['exit_code']==0
print(json.dumps({'schema':'ntru-e2e-final-artifact-audit-v1','phase1_acceptance_passed':True,'all_predefined_instances_recorded':True,'online_wall_seconds':summary['online_wall_seconds'],'records':records},indent=2))
